name: antigem-plugins
description: Official Antigem plugins repository: 2D Video Editing Studio (v3.3.1), Facebook Automation & SEO Studio (v1.7.0), and Meta Suite Page Management (v2.3.0).

plugins.name: 2d-video-editing-studio
plugins.description: Senior Video Editor & Autonomous 2D Production Engine (v3.3.1): Google Flow Agent Mode & Batch Dispatch, Anti-Offline Server Shield, 52-89 FPS High-Speed Render Presets, Instant Help CLI, 15-Minute Timeline Scaling Laws, Broadcast Vox explainers, Bento Box data cards, Stickman storytelling, and Multi-Domain Google Flow Bridge.

plugins.name: facebook-automation
plugins.description: Pre-Trained Phone (Desktop-on-Phone www.facebook.com & Mobile Touch m.facebook.com) and Desktop Facebook Automation Engine (v1.7.0): Dedicated Feed Posts (Text/Photo/Carousel/Video), Anti-Comment Firewall (strictly never posts into comments), Reels (/reels/create + automatic mobile fallback + video event dispatch), Stories (/stories/create Photo/Video with overlay story_text & Text Story), Real Video/Reel Thumbnail & Cover Uploader, Multiline Formatted Caption Engine (Title + Description + Bullets + CTA + 3-6 #Hashtags), and Zero-Overthinking 1-Call Dispatch.

plugins.name: meta-suite-automation
plugins.description: Master Autonomous Meta Suite Production Engine (v2.3.0): Enterprise Meta Business Suite Facebook Page management, auto-open Meta Business Suite on login, persistent bridge background thread, embedded multi-platform trend radar, 1-click publishing & scheduling of Page Reels, Long Videos, Photos, Stories with in-memory DataTransfer injection, synthetic clipboard paste, anti-ad organic shield, and Google Flow AI media generation.
